text: The company availed a Rs 12 crore supply-chain finance line from HDFC Bank to fund higher steel inventory.
Board approved raising working capital of Rs 40 million through invoice discounting on the TReDS platform with a new NBFC.
Kotak Mahindra Bank sanctioned a term loan of Rs 250 million for the new motor plant.
ICRA revised the long-term rating of the company to [ICRA]BBB- (Negative) from [ICRA]BBB (Stable).
CRISIL placed the company's bank loan ratings on 'Rating Watch with Negative Implications'.
The Chief Financial Officer has resigned with effect from 30 November; the search for a successor has begun.
Mr. R. Iyer has been appointed Managing Director and CEO, replacing the co-founder who moves to a non-executive role.
Promoter group entity sold 4.2% of its stake in a block deal to an institutional investor.
The promoter pledged 18% of his shareholding with a non-banking finance company.
The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs 1.50 per equity share.
Shareholders approved a buyback of equity shares worth Rs 30 crore.
The company invested Rs 50 million as equity in its Bangladesh subsidiary to fund local distribution.
The company acquired a 51% stake in a Pune-based BLDC motor start-up, making it a subsidiary.
The Board approved a scheme of amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary into the company.
Members approved alteration of the Articles of Association to create a new class of preference shares.
The company made a preferential allotment of 25 lakh equity shares to a family office.
The company sold its idle Raipur warehouse land to a real-estate developer for Rs 9 crore.
A second charge on the Bhilai factory land was created in favour of a new equipment lender.
The company announced it will enter real-estate development through a new division.
An advance of Rs 6 crore was extended to an associate concern owned by the promoter's family.
The company repaid Rs 3 crore of unsecured loans taken earlier from the promoter.
The SIDBI term loan was foreclosed ahead of schedule using surplus cash.
The October interest instalment to Punjab National Bank was paid 19 days after the due date.
RBL Bank reported the cash credit account as SMA-1 in the CRILC return for November.
An operational creditor filed a petition before the NCLT under Section 9 of the IBC against the company.
Another lender recalled its channel-finance facility citing irregularities in the account.
A fire at the Bhilai rolling unit halted production for an expected six weeks.
The pollution control board suspended the consent to operate for the Kohka plant.
The company launched a new range of smart ceiling fans with voice control.
The company won the 'Best Employer 2026' award from a business magazine.
The vehicle loan EMI for October was paid on the due date.
The company will hold its quarterly earnings call on 12 November.
The company spent Rs 40 lakh on a CSR project for rural schools.
A new distributor was appointed for the Kerala market.
The company opened a service centre in Guwahati.
The statutory auditor issued an unmodified limited-review report for the September quarter.
